channel.title: Global Supply Chain Bulletin
channel.description: An independent daily briefing on supply chains, energy transition and trade geopolitics.

item.title: Issue 128 — UKMTO reports two tanker incidents near the Strait of Hormuz, one vessel striking a mine, Euronews and gCaptain report
item.description: The Africa Report and Mining Weekly report Congo's government moved Nov. 24 to suspend cobalt exports again from month's end over falling prices, sending Chinese cobalt benchmarks to a three-month high, while Mining Weekly and MINING.COM report Panama said First Quantum accepted five conditions to resume Cobre Panama copper-mine talks.

item.title: Issue 127 — UKMTO reports two tanker incidents near the Strait of Hormuz, one vessel striking a mine, Euronews and gCaptain report
item.description: Euronews and Al Arabiya report Iran vowed Nov. 23 to use 'every means' to counter a US blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, a day after UKMTO logged two tanker incidents there that Euronews and gCaptain say included one vessel striking a mine.

item.title: Issue 126 — UKMTO reports two tanker incidents near the Strait of Hormuz, one vessel striking a mine, Euronews and gCaptain report
item.description: Euronews, Al Arabiya and gCaptain report UKMTO logged two tanker incidents near the Strait of Hormuz on Nov. 22, one vessel striking a mine, as IMF PortWatch data still show transits stuck near a record-low 2.3 ships a day.

item.title: Issue 125 — ADNOC confirms one crew member missing, 11 injured after a tanker is struck in the Strait of Hormuz, Seatrade Maritime and Reuters report
item.description: Reuters and Al Arabiya report the US Senate voted 51-48 on Nov. 19 to block a resolution curbing Trump's Iran war powers, as IMF PortWatch data still show Hormuz transits stuck near a record-low 2.3 ships a day after ADNOC's tanker attack.

item.title: Issue 124 — ADNOC confirms one crew member missing, 11 injured after a tanker is struck in the Strait of Hormuz, Seatrade Maritime and Reuters report
item.description: Seatrade Maritime, gCaptain, Reuters and Al Arabiya report ADNOC L&S confirmed one crew member missing and 11 injured after its tanker Navig8 Messi was struck in the Strait of Hormuz on Nov. 17, the second attack on an ADNOC vessel in four months.

item.title: Issue 123 — US military strikes an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz, Reuters and Al Arabiya report
item.description: Reuters, Al Arabiya and gCaptain report US fighter jets struck an Iranian missile site on Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz on Nov. 17, hours after Reuters and Al Arabiya separately report a gas tanker's crew abandoned ship off Oman following a projectile strike.

item.title: Issue 122 — Iran's navy says tankers catch fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz, Reuters and Al Arabiya report
item.description: gCaptain, Reuters and Euronews report a reported sea-drone attack sank a cargo ship off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast on Nov. 16, as Reuters and Al Arabiya separately report Iran's navy says two tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Issue 121 — Iran's navy says tankers catch fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz, Reuters and Al Arabiya report
item.description: Reuters, Al Arabiya and gCaptain report Iran's navy and IRGC say tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz on Nov. 14-15, as Reuters and Al Arabiya separately report Bahrain intercepted Iranian aerial attacks while Tehran says it struck a US radar site.

item.title: Issue 120 — Commerce denies a reported clash with Bessent over not blacklisting Nvidia's China-linked customer Megaspeed, AP and Bloomberg report
item.description: AP, Bloomberg, the Financial Times and Axios report Commerce denies a clash with Treasury Secretary Bessent over not blacklisting Nvidia's China-linked customer Megaspeed, as Business Standard and Euronews report a Senate panel has summoned Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick to testify.

item.title: Issue 119 — US formalizes a two-month extension of its China ship port-fee suspension, gCaptain, Mining Weekly and Seatrade Maritime report
item.description: gCaptain, Mining Weekly and Seatrade Maritime report Washington and Beijing have both formally extended their reciprocal port-fee and tariff-pause truce by two months, into January 2027.

item.title: Issue 118 — Saudi Arabia reports a new attack on its East-West pipeline, Reuters and Al Jazeera report
item.description: Reuters and Al Arabiya report Saudi air defenses intercepted Houthi missiles bound for the Riyadh region on Nov. 11, with debris falling in the Mecca region, as the kingdom's East-West pipeline remains hit by last week's unclaimed attack near Medina.

item.title: Issue 117 — Saudi Arabia reports a new attack on its East-West pipeline, Reuters and Al Jazeera report
item.description: Reuters, Al Arabiya and the Hindu report Hormuz LNG tanker traffic hit its highest October level since the war began, even as Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline remains hit by a fresh, unclaimed attack and Brent holds near $92 a barrel.

item.title: Issue 116 — Saudi Arabia reports a new attack on its East-West pipeline, Reuters and Al Jazeera report
item.description: Al Jazeera, Reuters and Al Arabiya report Saudi state media said the kingdom's East-West oil pipeline was hit in a fresh attack on Nov. 9, as Reuters and Al Arabiya separately report Trump told Reuters that Qatar and Saudi Arabia want a peaceful end to the Iran standoff while the US stays ready to act.

item.title: Issue 115 — Houthi missiles are intercepted over Riyadh as debris damages a Saudi Aramco building, Reuters and AP report
item.description: Reuters, the Associated Press, Al Arabiya and Times of Israel report Saudi air defenses intercepted Houthi missiles over Riyadh on Nov. 8, with debris damaging a Saudi Aramco administrative building in the capital's financial district; Reuters, Times of Israel and Al Arabiya separately report the US military continues weighing new curbs on Iranian land commerce.

item.title: Issue 114 — Expanding on its naval blockade, the US military looks to restrict Iranian land commerce, Reuters reports
item.description: Reuters, Times of Israel and Al Arabiya report the US military is weighing new curbs on Iranian land commerce as an expansion of its naval blockade, as Hormuz transits hold near 4.4/day; Times of Israel and Axios separately report Treasury Secretary Bessent is reaching out to China to help end the conflict after Republicans' midterm defeat.

item.title: Issue 113 — A seafarer is killed in a Gulf tanker attack as Iran's nuclear proposal to the US via Qatar stalls, Reuters reports
item.description: Reuters, gCaptain, Deutsche Welle and Seatrade Maritime report a seafarer was killed in a suspected missile attack on a tanker in the Gulf on Nov. 6, as Brent crude eased to $97.76; Al Arabiya separately notes Iran's Nov. 5 nuclear proposal to the US via Qatar remains unanswered.

item.title: Issue 112 — Iran sent a nuclear proposal to the US via Qatar as Brent crude rebounds to $99 a barrel, Reuters and Al Arabiya report
item.description: Hellenic Shipping News, Al Jazeera and Al Arabiya report Iran's Revolutionary Guard navy claimed five tankers and a tugboat caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz on Nov. 5, as Brent crude rebounded to $99.20 a barrel; Reuters and Al Arabiya separately report Iran sent a nuclear proposal to the US via Qatar.

item.title: Issue 111 — Brent crude falls below $100 a barrel; hopes rise for a US-Iran peace deal after Democrats' midterm win, FT and Al Arabiya report
item.description: The Financial Times, Economic Times and Al Arabiya report Brent crude fell under $100 a barrel on Nov. 4; a US-Iran peace deal looked more likely after Democrats' midterm win, as Mining Weekly and MINING.COM report Freeport-McMoRan approved a $4.5 billion expansion of its Bagdad, Arizona copper mine.

item.title: Issue 110 — US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz, Reuters and Livemint report
item.description: MINING.COM and Bloomberg report Congo seized thousands of tons of copper and cobalt in a crackdown on illegal mining, as Livemint and the Associated Press report India's Navy freed 20 Iranian crew from a Somali pirate-hijacked fishing vessel after a 48-hour operation.

item.title: Issue 109 — US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island near the Strait of Hormuz, Reuters and Livemint report
item.description: Reuters and Livemint report Brent rose to $104.92 a barrel after a US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island, according to Reuters, as the Associated Press and Al Arabiya separately report Khamenei warned any new US or Israeli attack would draw a response with no 'geographic limits.'

item.title: Issue 108 — Iran's Guard says two more tankers exploded in the Strait of Hormuz as Washington again withholds comment
item.description: Reuters and Al Jazeera report Iran's Revolutionary Guard navy now says two more tankers exploded in the Strait of Hormuz, a day after gCaptain and Al Arabiya reported its tally had risen to four, as Washington's CENTCOM has not commented on the new claim.

item.title: Issue 107 — Iran's Guard says four tankers now on fire in the Strait of Hormuz as Washington again rejects its mine account
item.description: gCaptain, Al Arabiya, Euronews and Times of Israel report Iran's Revolutionary Guard navy now says four tankers have caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz, up from the three it reported a day earlier, as Washington's CENTCOM continues to reject Iran's mine account.

item.title: Issue 106 — Tanker in the Strait of Hormuz hit by limpet mines, UKMTO says, as Iran's Guard reports three vessels on fire
item.description: Reuters and gCaptain report a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz was hit by limpet mines on Oct. 30, UKMTO says, as Iran's Revolutionary Guard separately claims three tankers caught fire; Al Arabiya carries both accounts and Washington has not commented.

item.title: Issue 105 — Iran's Hormuz authority threatens Sinokor tankers with legal action from Nov. 1, Reuters reports
item.description: Deutsche Welle and Al Arabiya report a ship caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz on Oct. 29 as Iran's Nov. 1 deadline for Sinokor's tanker fleet approaches, with IMF PortWatch's latest count holding transits near 3.3 a day.

item.title: Issue 104 — Iran's Hormuz authority threatens Sinokor tankers with legal action from Nov. 1, Reuters reports
item.description: Euronews and Reuters report Europe's benchmark gas price crossed €100 per megawatt-hour on Oct. 28 for the first time since the 2022 crisis, as EU energy chief Dan Jørgensen warned of a difficult winter.

item.title: Issue 103 — Iran's Hormuz authority threatens Sinokor tankers with legal action from Nov. 1, Reuters reports
item.description: Reuters, gCaptain and Seatrade Maritime report Iran's Strait Authority will take legal action against Sinokor's tanker fleet in the Strait of Hormuz from Nov. 1, while Al Arabiya and Nikkei Asia report a Saudi-led coalition continues intercepting Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh.

item.title: Issue 102 — Iran claims control of Strait of Hormuz, warns US warships against entry, Livemint reports
item.description: Al Arabiya and Nikkei Asia report a Saudi-led coalition continues intercepting Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh, while the Associated Press and Livemint report many Iranians now fear a return to all-out war once US midterm and Israeli elections pass.

item.title: Issue 101 — Iran claims control of Strait of Hormuz, warns US warships against entry, Livemint reports
item.description: Al Arabiya and Nikkei Asia report a Saudi-led coalition downed more than 10 Houthi missiles aimed at Riyadh on Oct. 25, while Reuters reports the kingdom's main airport reopened only partially; Trading Economics puts Brent at $115.24 a barrel Monday, off Friday's six-month high.

item.title: Issue 100 — Iran claims control of Strait of Hormuz, warns US warships against entry, Livemint reports
item.description: Brent crude held near $116.72 a barrel Friday, up over 3% on the week per Trading Economics, as Livemint and Reuters reported Iran now claims to control the Strait of Hormuz and is warning US warships to stay out of the Gulf.

item.title: Issue 99 — Iran's IRGC says seven vessels hit mines near Hormuz, threatens US bases over tanker escorts
item.description: Nikkei Asia and Euronews report an oil spill hit UAE beaches as tanker attacks multiplied near Hormuz, sending Brent to $116.91 a barrel, up 3.30% and its highest since April, per Trading Economics.
